caption:
Gartner said that by 2026, one in five organisations would use AI to cut half their middle management roles. That deadline is now three months from expiring.

Q1 2026: over 78,000 global tech layoffs, nearly half attributed to AI. Indian IT firms are reporting Q2 FY27 headcount in this results window.

Look hard at what you've been using as proof of your value. Coordination. Status reports. Running the deck. Chasing updates across three teams. That is the exact layer being automated.

What does not automate: judgment under pressure, and the presence to make that judgment land in a room full of senior people.

In 35 years of command, the officers who mattered were never the ones with the tidiest reporting. They were the ones who could hold a room, speak once, and be believed.

Bearing. Tone. Calculated silence. These are not soft skills. They are now the only skills a machine cannot take from you.

topic.title: Gartner's 2026 deadline: AI is eating middle management
topic.angle: Lumina's audience is exactly the qualified mid-tier manager whose proof-of-value — coordination, status reporting, running the deck — is the part being automated, leaving judgment and presence as the only non-automatable layer.
